 Live Updates 
 Live updates: Sixers look to extend winning streak against struggling Bucks 
 Follow along for live updates as the Sixers look to keep rolling in Saturday's matinee against Milwaukee. 
 By Karli Cauley • 
 Published 2 hours ago • 
 Updated 4 seconds ago 
 BOOKMARKER 
 Share 
 IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect 
 Nov 18, 2026; Orlando, Florida, USA; Philadelphia 76ers forward LeBron James (23) reacts after a basket against the Orlando Magic in the fourth quarter at Kia Center. Mandatory Credit: Nathan Ray Seebeck-Imagn Images
 What to Know
 The Sixers opened the season series with a 127–116 win over Milwaukee on Oct. 24, fueled by Joel Embiid’s triple-double. 
 Jaylen Brown (hamstring) and Dean Wade (hamstring) have been ruled out.
 Tyrese Maxey and Dominick Barlow have both been upgraded to available.
 Philadelphia has won four out of their last five games, while Milwaukee is on a 12 game losing streak.
 The Sixers are 6–2 at home this season, while Milwaukee is 0–7 on the road.
 Watch Sixers-Bucks at 1:00 p.m. ET on NBC Sports Philadelphia. 
 Good afternoon 🤩
 View this post on Instagram 
 Sixers' 1st-quarter struggles continue
 The Sixers started the day with a minus-13.2 net rating in first quarters, which ranked 28th in the NBA. 
 We’ll see how they close out the first quarter vs. the Bucks, but they face an early seven-point deficit. Joel Embiid has missed his first four field goals and had two shots rejected by Myles Turner. Tyler Herro’s second three-pointer gave Milwaukee a 15-8 lead.
